testCases.title: Create Organization (Happy Path)

preconditions.state: No organization named 'Test Org Alpha' exists

steps: Open the User Access Management console (system-admin page)
Enter address selecting city, state and country from the reference dropdowns
expectedResults: Organization record created with name='Test Org Alpha', isActive=true
Process 'UAM Create or Update Organization' completes
The new organization appears in the organizations list

testCases.title: Update Organization details
cleanup: Revert the contact change via pre-provisioned data reset

testCases.title: Create parent/child organization hierarchy

preconditions.state: Parent 'Test Org Alpha' and child 'Test Sub-Org Beta' exist, unlinked

steps: Use the sub-organization select grid to add 'Test Sub-Org Beta'
expectedResults: A UAM Organization Hierarchy Data row links parent='Test Org Alpha' to child='Test Sub-Org Beta'
The child appears under the parent's mapped sub-organizations view

testCases.title: Organization address requires reference-data city/state/country
steps: On the address section, confirm City/State/Country are dropdowns bound to reference data
Attempt to submit without selecting country
expectedResults: City/State/Country are constrained to reference values (UAM Ref City/State/Country)
Submission is blocked or the field flags a validation error when country is empty
assertions: Address record only accepts FK values present in UAM Ref Country / Ref State / Ref City

testCases.title: Organization audit fields auto-populate
expectedResults: createdByUser, createdOn, modifiedByUser, modifiedOn are auto-populated; isActive defaults true
